purpose: Teach: 久美子/節子/涼子/亜紀/いずみ/千里/かおり/片側

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがご友人の久美子さんと文通された
lines.en: You know, when your father was young, he used to exchange letters with his friend Kumiko.
lines.style: Gentle, almost dreamlike recall. Voice softens on the memory itself. Paced to allow weight to settle. Searching tone — not quite present, sifting through time.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、節子さんと俳句を詠まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and when you were young, you used to write haiku with Setsuko, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, knowing tenderness in the push-back. Light tease underneath. A woman reminding her husband that his own past mirrors the present moment. Affectionate anchor on 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが妹の涼子さんを可愛がられた
lines.en: When your father was young, he was quite fond of his sister Ryoko.
lines.style: Same distant, reflective quality as before. Quieter this time — a softer memory. Pause before the name, as if conjuring her face. Voice gentles further.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、姪の亜紀さんと旅行されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you took trips with your niece Aki, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Mirror image of her second line — same structure, same affectionate tease. Comfortable rhythm now, building a pattern. Gentle firmness on the redirect back to him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが従妹のいずみさんとお酒を酌み交わされた
lines.en: When your father was young, he and his cousin Izumi used to share drinks together.
lines.style: Softer still. The wistfulness settling deeper. Voice almost conversational now but still distant — a man speaking to himself as much as to her. Thoughtful pause at the names.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、千里おばさんと将棋を指されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you used to play shogi with Aunt Chisato, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Same warm, knowing callback. A rhythm now established between them — she answers every wistful gaze with a gentle correction. Smile audible underneath. Steady, present anchor.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがお孫のかおりさんを可愛がられた
lines.en: When your father was young, he was very fond of his granddaughter Kaori.
lines.style: The last one. Voice drops slightly lower. A man reaching the end of a thought, or perhaps running out of people to remember. Gentleness mixed with something final. Slowest pace yet.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、足の片側を痛められたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you hurt your leg rather badly, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Sharp, precise. A gentle interruption — not accusation but assertion. She's breaking the pattern intentionally now, bringing him back to earth. Warm but firm. A wife who knows when her husband needs grounding.
